run_GIL_scoped_callback_test: run the pybind11 GIL scoped callback test to verify C++ to Python round-trip works without deadlock
test_GIL_deadlock_single_thread: test that Python to C++ to Python callbacks do not cause GIL deadlock in a single thread
test_GIL_deadlock_parallel_threads: test that Python to C++ to Python callbacks do not cause GIL deadlock across 8 parallel threads
test_GIL_deadlock_sequential_threads: test that Python to C++ to Python callbacks do not cause GIL deadlock across 8 sequential threads
run_process_with_timeout: run a target function in a separate process with a 10 second timeout and return its exit code
